places.name: Victoria Peak
places.ai_summary: The highest point on Hong Kong Island, offering stunning panoramic views of the city skyline, harbor, and surrounding islands.

opening_hours.notes: Evenings are popular for the illuminated city views.

places.place_tip: Take the Peak Tram for a unique experience.
places.address: Victoria Peak, Hong Kong

places.ai_summary: A magical theme park featuring thrilling rides, enchanting shows, and beloved Disney characters, perfect for families and kids.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for special events and parades.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to avoid long queues for popular rides.

places.name: Tian Tan Buddha (Big Buddha)
places.ai_summary: A massive bronze statue of Buddha Shakyamuni, symbolizing harmony and enlightenment, located on Lantau Island.

opening_hours.notes: Climbing the 268 steps to the statue is a must-do experience.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a ride on the Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car.
places.address: Ngong Ping Rd, Lantau Island, Hong Kong

places.ai_summary: A scenic cable car ride offering breathtaking views of Lantau Island, the South China Sea, and the famous Big Buddha statue.

opening_hours.notes: Operating hours may vary; check the official website for updates.

places.place_tip: Book a round-trip ticket for a complete experience.
places.address: Ngong Ping, Lantau Island, Hong Kong

places.ai_summary: The stunning skyline of Hong Kong, best viewed from Victoria Harbour, featuring the Symphony of Lights show with illuminated buildings and laser displays.
places.name_english: Hong Kong Skyline & Symphony of Lights

places.place_tip: Find a good spot along the waterfront for the best view.
places.address: Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong

places.ai_summary: A bustling night market in Jordan, known for its vibrant atmosphere, street food, and a wide variety of goods including clothing, accessories, and souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit in the evening when the market is fully operational.

places.place_tip: Try the street food and explore the various stalls.

places.name: Ocean Park
places.ai_summary: A marine-life theme park in Wong Chuk Hang, featuring animal exhibits, rides, and shows, offering a fun and educational experience for visitors of all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for animal feeding times and shows.

places.place_tip: Visit the panda habitat and take the hair-raising rides.

places.name: Ladies Market (Mong Kok)
places.ai_summary: A famous street market in Mong Kok, known for its bargain clothing, accessories, and souvenirs, as well as its vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit in the evening when the market is cooler and more lively.

places.place_tip: Bargain with the vendors for the best deals.
places.address: Ladies Market, Mong Kok, Hong Kong

places.name: Wong Tai Sin Temple
places.ai_summary: A famous Taoist temple in Wong Tai Sin, known for its beautiful architecture, religious significance, and the practice of Kau Cim (a form of fortune telling).

opening_hours.notes: The temple is especially crowded during the Chinese New Year period.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to try Kau Cim for a unique experience.
places.address: Wong Tai Sin Temple, Wong Tai Sin, Hong Kong

places.name: Man Mo Temple
places.ai_summary: A historic temple in Sheung Wan, dedicated to the gods of literature (Man) and war (Mo), known for its incense-filled atmosphere and beautiful architecture.

opening_hours.notes: A peaceful retreat from the bustling city, best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Take time to explore the surrounding streets for a glimpse of old Hong Kong.
places.address: Man Mo Temple, Sheung Wan, Hong Kong

places.name: Stanley Market
places.ai_summary: A popular market in Stanley, known for its wide range of products including clothing, accessories, and souvenirs, as well as its picturesque seaside location.

opening_hours.notes: The market is less crowded in the morning; great for photography.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at one of the seaside restaurants for fresh seafood.
places.address: Stanley Market, Stanley, Hong Kong

places.name: Repulse Bay
places.ai_summary: A beautiful beach located in the southern part of Hong Kong Island, known for its crescent-shaped shoreline, clear waters, and the iconic Repulse Bay Hotel.

opening_hours.notes: The beach is monitored by lifeguards during the day; swimming is safe.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Tin Hau Temple for a cultural experience.
places.address: Repulse Bay, Hong Kong

places.name: Avenue of Stars
places.ai_summary: A promenade located along the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront, celebrating Hong Kong's film industry with stars' handprints, sculptures, and a stunning view of the skyline.

opening_hours.notes: The promenade is especially beautiful at night when the skyline is illuminated.

places.place_tip: Don't forget to take a photo with the Bruce Lee statue.
places.address: Avenue of Stars, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for hidden bars and local favorites.

places.ai_summary: A unique monastery in Sha Tin, featuring thousands of Buddha statues lining the paths and halls, set in a beautiful and tranquil environment.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a stroll in the nearby Sha Tin Park.
